dashboard.label: Weather Overview
dashboard.description: Normalized ZENTRA Cloud v4 field logger observations from the Weather data model.

search.query: | datamodel Weather Weather search | search Weather.device_sn=$device_sn$ | rename "Weather.*" as *
`zentra_weather_search` | stats count by device_sn | sort device_sn
| stats latest(air_temperature) as temp latest(air_temperature_unit) as unit | eval value = if(isnotnull(temp), temp." ".coalesce(unit,""), "n/a") | fields value
| stats latest(relative_humidity) as rh latest(relative_humidity_unit) as unit | eval value = if(isnotnull(rh), rh." ".coalesce(unit,""), "n/a") | fields value
| stats latest(wind_speed) as wind latest(wind_speed_unit) as unit | eval value = if(isnotnull(wind), wind." ".coalesce(unit,""), "n/a") | fields value
| stats sum(precipitation) as precip latest(precipitation_unit) as unit | eval value = if(isnotnull(precip), round(precip, 2)." ".coalesce(unit,""), "n/a") | fields value
| timechart span=15m avg(air_temperature) as air_temperature by device_sn
| timechart span=15m avg(relative_humidity) as relative_humidity by device_sn
| timechart span=15m avg(wind_speed) as wind_speed max(gust_speed) as gust_speed
| timechart span=1h sum(precipitation) as precipitation by device_sn

| stats latest(air_temperature) as air_temperature latest(latitude) as latitude latest(longitude) as longitude by device_sn | geostats latfield=latitude longfield=longitude latest(air_temperature) as air_temperature by device_sn

| stats latest(_time) as last_seen latest(air_temperature) as air_temperature latest(relative_humidity) as relative_humidity latest(wind_speed) as wind_speed latest(precipitation) as precipitation latest(solar_radiation) as solar_radiation latest(battery_percent) as battery_percent latest(error_flag) as error_flag by device_sn device_name | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort device_sn
